verdicts.evidence: Track 1 sec 2-3: all barley activities 'Within scope'; registration 'current and active'

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 sec 5.2: 6mm mesh on openings, sealed envelope, flashed penetrations

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 sec 5.3: bunded waste pad, grease-trap/sewer, wet scrubber to holding pond

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 sec 6 waste streams/frequencies; Track 2 sec 6 Waste Management Procedure

verdicts.evidence: Track 6 master cleaning schedule + verification (ATP swabs); Track 4 waste SOP

verdicts.evidence: Track 7 monitoring/servicing schedule; Track 2 sec 7 IPM (detection worked)

verdicts.evidence: Track 3: pest records 2021-2025 (>=2yr); Track 6 sec 8.1 stored 'at least two years'

verdicts.evidence: Track 6 sec 11 all areas maintained; Track 4 sec 7.1 clean; Track 3 condition record clean

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 sec 7.2: Indian meal moth 42/trap (threshold 10); 'Live larvae found in one product sample'

verdicts.evidence: Track 1 chemical store lockable/bunded/separate; Track 3 chemicals in locked cage, 'No risk to grain'

verdicts.evidence: Track 9 sheet 4 Dispatch/Transfer Dockets: destination premises, dest RE, seals
